AssetReconciliationRow.description:
One base asset: managed books versus the venue's total holding.

``venue_quantity`` sums every venue balance row of the currency (duplicate wallet
rows are summed, and ``venue_rows`` discloses when there was more than one).
``foreign_quantity`` is ``venue - managed_net``: positive means external holdings
the installation does not manage (not an error); negative means the venue holds
less than managed books claim.
AssetReconciliationRow.title: AssetReconciliationRow

AuditFailureEvidence.description: One historical failure and an explicitly matched later recovery, when observed.
AuditFailureEvidence.title: AuditFailureEvidence

BacktestCostAttribution.description:
Sum recorded closed-trade amounts, preserving execution costs and rounding evidence.

Fill-price PnL already includes modeled spread/slippage. ``accounting_residual`` is
net minus (before-fees PnL minus both fees); ``summary_net_pnl_delta`` is the canonical
summary net minus ledger net. Neither difference is silently attributed to fees.
BacktestCostAttribution.title: BacktestCostAttribution

BacktestEvaluationWindow.description:
Which bars one result evaluated, derived from its run; never part of result bytes.

``evaluation_start`` is the first evaluated bar (inclusive) and ``evaluation_end`` the
exclusive bound whose bar's open liquidates a position still held. A backtest with
omitted bounds starts after the strategy's own warmup, so two strategies on one dataset
can cover different windows (BTC-USDC 1d buy-and-hold read 48% with a 60-bar warmup and
129% with 110). Pin both bounds when comparing strategies (ADR 0094).
BacktestEvaluationWindow.title: BacktestEvaluationWindow

BacktestPerformanceMetrics.description: Derived ratio metrics from one immutable equity curve and trade ledger.
BacktestPerformanceMetrics.title: BacktestPerformanceMetrics

BarDecision.description:
What one paper/live strategy bot decided on one completed bar, and why.

Identity is ``(deployment_id, product_id, bar_starts_at)``; writes are upserts, so
a restart replay rewrites the same row instead of duplicating it. ``no_trade_bar``
is true when the bar was a flat zero-volume bar for an interval without trades
(ADR 0095): it was evaluated like any bar, and records written before that ADR
read as false.
BarDecision.title: BarDecision

ComparisonOperator.title: ComparisonOperator

ConditionComparisonTrace.title: ConditionComparisonTrace

ConditionResult.description: Tri-state result of one rule node: undefined inputs are unknown, never false.

DatasetCoverageRow.description:
Local verified coverage plus watchlist and worker facts for one target.

For a watched target, ``complete`` means the verified series spans the watch
lookback (``watch_complete``); ``island_complete`` keeps the dataset-level fact. A
two-minute dataset for a 90-day watch is not complete. Coverage is reported as
``watch_covered_candle_count`` of ``watch_expected_candle_count`` bars (with
``watch_coverage_ratio``). ``watch_sparsity`` is ``gapped`` when ``watch_complete``
is false, even if the published island itself has zero gaps. ``watch_status``
restates ``watch_complete`` as an operator noun so ``worker_status=succeeded``
(latest chunk only) cannot be misread as a finished backfill.
``history_floor_at`` is set only when the listing search found no provider candle
before the island (the market had not traded yet): coverage legitimately starts
there and the watch counts as complete from that floor.
``synthetic_no_trade_intervals`` counts the flat zero-volume bars published for
confirmed no-trade intervals (ADR 0095).
DatasetCoverageRow.title: DatasetCoverageRow

Which exit rule closed (or is closing) the position on this bar.

``signal`` is the strategy's ``exits.signal_exit`` rule (ADR 0093).

DecisionProtectionUpdate.description: Observed protection changes, linked independently of entry cancellations.
DecisionProtectionUpdate.title: DecisionProtectionUpdate

DecisionRisk.description: The risk-registry or freshness verdict that admitted or refused an entry.
DecisionRisk.title: DecisionRisk

DecisionSkipReason.description:
Why the entry rule was not evaluated, or why a matched rule rested no entry.

``entry_geometry`` and ``entry_sizing`` (ADR 0090) mark a matched signal whose
stop/target geometry or cash/venue-minimum sizing refused the order; the row's
``reason_code`` names the exact cause (for example ``TARGET_NOT_POSITIVE``).
``reference_data_stale`` and ``reference_data_missing`` (ADR 0096) mark a bar whose
read-only reference instrument had no usable closed bar, so no entry was attempted.
DecisionSkipReason.title: DecisionSkipReason

DecisionsPayload.description: Same per-bar decision records as the deployment/strategy decision HTTP pages.
DecisionsPayload.title: DecisionsPayload

DecisionsReport.description: Read-only per-bar decision timeline: what each bot decided on every bar, and why.
DecisionsReport.title: DecisionsReport

DeliveryStatus.description: What happened after a confirmation-gated notify request.
DeliveryStatus.title: DeliveryStatus

DeploymentBookSummary.description:
One product book without quantities or order payloads.

``position_state`` / ``exit_in_flight`` (ADR 0097) say whether an open book merely
rests its protection (``open_protected``) or is exiting; ``phase`` stays raw.

protection.description: Quantitative stop cover (ADR 0112). Includes coverage quantities. Prices, cash, and order payloads stay omitted. Paper is worker-dependent, not a venue-resting stop. Null times mean unknown.

DeploymentBookSummary.title: DeploymentBookSummary

DeploymentMode.description: Venue selected when a published strategy is deployed.
DeploymentMode.title: DeploymentMode

DeploymentSummary.description:
One paper or live runtime without cash, quantities, or order payloads.

``position_state`` / ``exit_in_flight`` collapse every book (ADR 0097); they are null
only when the report could not read the deployment's books.
DeploymentSummary.title: DeploymentSummary

EntryConditionOutcome.description: Auditable outcome of one completed-candle entry-condition evaluation.
EntryConditionOutcome.title: EntryConditionOutcome

EntryFillDigest.description: One twin's entry-order outcomes (ADR 0097); decimals are canonical strings.

average_fill_vs_limit_bps.description: Positive is worse than the posted limit; null with no fill.
average_fill_vs_limit_bps.title: Average Fill Vs Limit Bps

EntryFillDigest.title: EntryFillDigest

EntryRuleTrace.description:
The evaluated entry rule: combined outcome, rule tree, HTF filter, and values.

``signal`` is the same ``SignalTraceRecord`` research emits per candle, so paper,
live, and backtest evidence share one shape for indicator values on a bar.
EntryRuleTrace.title: EntryRuleTrace

EvidenceKind.description: Optional pointer at immutable evidence; not a substitute for that evidence.
EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind

ExchangePayload.description: Detected exchange connection facts without balances or account ids.
ExchangePayload.title: ExchangePayload

ExitRuleTrace.description:
The evaluated ``exits.signal_exit`` rule on a bar the book was open (ADR 0093).

Recorded on every post-fill bar the rule was evaluated, so a holding bar shows why it
did not exit and an exit bar shows the leaves that matched.
ExitRuleTrace.title: ExitRuleTrace

FeesPayload.description: Coinbase fee tier plus the research/paper prefill (account rates) and schedule context.
FeesPayload.title: FeesPayload

ForeignOpenOrderRow.description: One nonterminal venue order no complete managed listing claims.
ForeignOpenOrderRow.title: ForeignOpenOrderRow

FundingContractSummary.description:
Funding coverage for one perp-style contract in the report window.

``latest_rate`` is the newest stored hour's rate; ``latest_settled`` is false while
the listing still names that hour. ``gap_times`` lists at most 24 missing hours.
``twenty_four_by_seven`` is false for a contract with trading sessions (index perps):
its closed-session hours show as gaps but do not degrade the report; ``null`` means no
contract observation was recorded.
FundingContractSummary.title: FundingContractSummary

FundingPayload.description: Funding history visible to agents; no account data is involved.
FundingPayload.title: FundingPayload

FundingPollerSummary.description: The futures poller's last attempt and success.
FundingPollerSummary.title: FundingPollerSummary

FundingRateRow.description: One stored funding hour (only when the report is scoped to one contract).
FundingRateRow.title: FundingRateRow

FundingReport.description: Read-only CFM funding-rate history and poller health.
FundingReport.title: FundingReport

FuturesAccountPayload.description:
The latest mirror snapshot, or nothing before the first one.

``positions`` is ``null`` when the position read failed (unknown) and ``[]`` when the
venue reported none. ``read_failures`` lists ``operation:reason`` tokens.
``margin_ratio`` is ``available_margin / liquidation_threshold`` (``null`` when either
is unknown or the threshold is not positive, as on a flat account).
``collateral_note`` states that futures buying power is shared with the USDC spot
balance.

collateral_note.default: Coinbase counts the USDC spot balance as CFM futures collateral (observed 2026-10-10): futures buying power is shared with USDC spot capital, not additional money. Amounts here are USD and are never added to USDC amounts.
collateral_note.title: Collateral Note

FuturesAccountPayload.title: FuturesAccountPayload

FuturesBalancePayload.description: The CFM balance summary; every amount is USD (``currency``).
FuturesBalancePayload.title: FuturesBalancePayload

FuturesCollateralPayload.description:
The gate's view of the shared USDC collateral pool.

``state`` is ``absent``, ``idle``, ``in_use`` or ``unknown``. USD figures come from the
newest CFM mirror snapshot; ``reserve_quote`` is in the policy quote. ``effect`` is what
the gate does to new live entries in the policy quote: ``none`` (idle or absent),
``not_linked`` (a USDT policy), ``live_spot_entries_denied``,
``reserve_short_entries_denied`` or ``reserve_withheld``.

collateral_note.default: Coinbase counts the USDC spot balance as CFM futures collateral (observed 2026-10-10): futures buying power is shared with USDC spot capital, not additional money. Amounts here are USD and are never added to USDC amounts.
collateral_note.title: Collateral Note

FuturesCollateralPayload.title: FuturesCollateralPayload

FuturesExternalPositionRow.description: One CFM position; ``notional_usd`` is ``null`` when its contract size is unknown.
FuturesExternalPositionRow.title: FuturesExternalPositionRow

FuturesPositionPayload.description: One open CFM position; ``number_of_contracts`` is in contracts, prices in USD.
FuturesPositionPayload.title: FuturesPositionPayload

FuturesProductSummary.description:
One Coinbase CFM futures contract from the read-only listing (ADR 0126).

``orderable`` is always false: no lane can order, adopt or deploy a futures contract.
``base_increment`` and ``base_min_size`` are in contracts; ``contract_size`` is the
``underlying`` quantity per contract. ``underlying`` is the venue's
``contract_root_unit`` (``BIP`` is BTC), never the id prefix. ``expires_at`` is null for
a perp, whose ``venue_expiry_at`` is a far-future sentinel; ``listed_expiry`` is the day
in the id. Margin rates are fractions of notional; ``funding_rate`` is per
``funding_interval_seconds`` (longs pay when positive). ``null`` means unlisted (unknown),
never zero.
FuturesProductSummary.title: FuturesProductSummary

FuturesReconciliationSection.description:
External CFM positions (mirror snapshot) and futures orders (fresh listing).

``positions_source`` is ``mirror_snapshot`` for a current snapshot, ``stale`` when it
is older than 180 s (positions then still shown but unproved), ``unavailable`` when the
position read failed and ``not_observed`` when no snapshot exists. ``positions`` is
``null`` when unknown. ``unmanaged_notional_usd`` sums every position's notional only
when all are known.

note.default: ThyTrader manages no futures, so every CFM position and futures order is external, unmanaged exposure (ADR 0127). Positions come from the newest read-only mirror snapshot; notional is USD (contracts x contract size x current price) and is never added to USDC. Futures margin draws on the USDC spot balance, which Coinbase counts as collateral.
note.title: Note

FuturesReconciliationSection.title: FuturesReconciliationSection

FuturesRiskPolicy.description:
Futures-related risk settings.

``live_spot_collateral_reserve_quote`` is an amount in the policy quote that live spot
books leave untouched for futures margin. While manual futures are ``in_use``, live
USDC/USD spot entries continue only when it is set, it covers the CFM initial margin
times ``peg_haircut`` (a yes/no threshold check; the two currencies are never added),
and it is withheld from the spot capital base. ``peg_haircut`` is ≥ 1.0.
FuturesRiskPolicy.title: FuturesRiskPolicy

HtfFilterTrace.description: The declared higher-timeframe filter, evaluated on its last completed bar.

IndicatorCatalogEntry.description:
One implemented indicator kind and its canonical input/parameter shape.

``parameter_kind``, ``period_min``/``period_max`` (the integer-parameter bounds),
and ``outputs`` keep their historical meaning; ``parameters`` is the complete,
authoritative parameter list.

supports_source.description: Whether the kind may read a reference instrument with `source` (ADR 0096); false only for constant.
supports_source.title: Supports Source

IndicatorCatalogEntry.title: IndicatorCatalogEntry

IndicatorParameterEntry.description:
One declared indicator parameter: bounds, builder default, and one-line help.

Integer bounds/defaults are JSON numbers; decimal ones are canonical decimal
strings. ``null`` bounds are unbounded. ``exclusive_minimum`` marks decimals that
must be strictly greater than ``minimum``. ``optional`` parameters are omitted
from documents unless set, and their ``default`` is ``null``.
IndicatorParameterEntry.title: IndicatorParameterEntry

IndicatorTraceValue.description: One named canonical indicator value or an explicit undefined state.
IndicatorTraceValue.title: IndicatorTraceValue

IndicatorsPayload.description: Implemented indicator registry. Listed kinds are the only legal catalog.
IndicatorsPayload.title: IndicatorsPayload

IndicatorsReport.description: Read-only list of strategy indicators the engine actually implements.
IndicatorsReport.title: IndicatorsReport

IntentPurpose.description:
Why the runtime created one order intent.

``SIGNAL_EXIT`` is the marketable exit sent when the strategy's ``exits.signal_exit``
rule matched on a closed bar (ADR 0093). ``ADOPTION`` opens inventory from coins the
venue account already held (ADR 0124); it is not an entry, so it never consumes the
entry-rate cap and is never cancelled as risk-increasing.
IntentPurpose.title: IntentPurpose

JournalEntry.description: One append-only fact, lesson, or note with required origin attribution.
JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry

LessonOutcome.description: How a lesson classifies the cited outcome. Facts and notes stay ``none``.
LessonOutcome.title: LessonOutcome

ManagedListingEvidence.description: Completeness of every live-book read, including stopped books with possible residuals.
ManagedListingEvidence.title: ManagedListingEvidence

ManagerPermissions.description:
What the manager agent's proposals may do without approval. It never places orders.

``may_rebalance`` auto-applies rebalances on a paper portfolio within the rolling
7-day ``max_weight_change_per_week`` budget (a live rebalance always waits for
approval); ``may_pause_sleeves`` auto-applies pausing a running sleeve;
``may_propose_sleeves`` lets the manager propose new sleeves, which always need
approval. Strategies place every trade (ADR 0091).

max_weight_change_per_week.description: Largest total weight a rebalance may move in a rolling week.
max_weight_change_per_week.title: Max Weight Change Per Week

ManagerPermissions.title: ManagerPermissions

ManagerSettings.description: The manager agent's mandate and permissions (the agent loop runs outside ThyTrader).
ManagerSettings.title: ManagerSettings

MarketDataPayload.description: Durable ingestion coverage for one product and dataset timeframe.
MarketDataPayload.title: MarketDataPayload

MarketDataReport.description: Market-data freshness, gaps, and verified coverage.
MarketDataReport.title: MarketDataReport

MemoryStatus.title: MemoryStatus

MonitorFinding.title: MonitorFinding

MonitorSnapshot.title: MonitorSnapshot

NotificationRecord.title: NotificationRecord

futures_order_paths.description: Always empty: no surface can order a futures contract (ADR 0126).
futures_order_paths.title: Futures Order Paths

OpsContractPayload.title: OpsContractPayload

OrderKind.description:
Maker, marketable, venue-native OCO, or venue stop-limit execution style.

``STOP_LIMIT`` is live-only stop-only protection for a book without a take-profit
(ADR 0090); paper never submits it. ``ADOPTION`` is never routed to any broker: it
records coins already held in the venue account that a live book took ownership of
at a mark (ADR 0124), and every broker refuses it.
OrderKind.title: OrderKind

OrderReconciliationSection.description:
Managed working orders versus all venue nonterminal spot orders.

``foreign``, ``orphan`` and ``matched`` are null when either evidence side is
incomplete, so omitted comparisons cannot imply an empty or fully managed venue.
OrderReconciliationSection.title: OrderReconciliationSection

OrphanManagedOrderRow.description: One managed working order a complete venue listing did not return.
OrphanManagedOrderRow.title: OrphanManagedOrderRow

PaperLiveFillComparison.description:
Explicit twins running verified identical rules, side by side (ADR 0105).

``strategy_fingerprint`` references the paper side; each digest names its own snapshot. Paper
waits run to the fill bar's close (a candle must trade through the limit); live waits
end at the venue fill.
PaperLiveFillComparison.title: PaperLiveFillComparison

PerformanceBookPayload.description: One product book within a deployment performance slice.
PerformanceBookPayload.title: PerformanceBookPayload

PerformancePayload.description:
One backtest, paper, or live performance slice with explicit provenance.

``window`` (backtests only, ADR 0094) names the evaluated bars: evaluation_start,
evaluation_end, warmup_bars, and the first and last evaluated bar.
PerformancePayload.title: PerformancePayload

PerformanceReport.description: Performance evidence that distinguishes backtest, paper, and live.
PerformanceReport.title: PerformanceReport

PortfolioBacktestDigest.description: The newest stored portfolio backtest's headline numbers.
PortfolioBacktestDigest.title: PortfolioBacktestDigest

PortfolioDigest.description: One portfolio as operators see it, with its deployment and breaker state (ADR 0091).
PortfolioDigest.title: PortfolioDigest

PortfolioLimits.description:
Shared limits stored on a portfolio (fractions of portfolio capital).

On a deployed portfolio the exposure caps bind every sleeve's new entries in the risk
gate, and the optional daily-loss and drawdown stops are portfolio breakers that pause
every sleeve and latch until an operator reset (ADR 0091). Portfolio backtests do not
simulate them.

max_total_exposure_fraction.description: Cap on all sleeves' combined position value.
max_total_exposure_fraction.title: Max Total Exposure Fraction

max_per_asset_fraction.description: Cap on position value in any one base asset.
max_per_asset_fraction.title: Max Per Asset Fraction

daily_loss_quote.description: Optional UTC-day loss stop in the quote currency.
daily_loss_quote.title: Daily Loss Quote

max_drawdown_fraction.description: Optional stop on drawdown from the portfolio's peak.
max_drawdown_fraction.title: Max Drawdown Fraction

PortfolioLimits.title: PortfolioLimits

PortfolioPayload.description:
Point-in-time portfolio matching GET /api/v1/portfolio without secrets.

``totals`` are exact per-currency totals (USD, USDC, USDT), never added together.
``total_value`` is the labelled USD-pegged approximation (those totals added 1:1;
``total_value_basis`` says so). Both are ``null`` / empty when the account could not
be read: an unknown balance is never reported as zero.
PortfolioPayload.title: PortfolioPayload

PortfolioSleeveDigest.description: One sleeve, its strategy, weight, and what blocks it (ADR 0088).
PortfolioSleeveDigest.title: PortfolioSleeveDigest

PortfoliosPayload.description:
Every portfolio (sleeves, allocation, limits, manager settings, newest backtest).

``paper_live_fill_comparisons`` compares the entry fills of explicitly linked paper
and live books with identical pinned trading rules (sleeves or standalone; ADR 0105).
PortfoliosPayload.title: PortfoliosPayload

PortfoliosReport.description: Read-only portfolio composition report without trading authority.
PortfoliosReport.title: PortfoliosReport

PositionSide.description: Spot inventory direction for one deployment.
PositionSide.title: PositionSide

ProductSummary.description:
One enabled spot product from the current catalog, with its order constraints.

Increments and minimum sizes are exact decimal strings straight from the venue
catalog: an order quantity must be a multiple of ``base_increment`` and at least
``base_min_size``, a limit price a multiple of ``price_increment``, and a quote
notional at least ``quote_min_size``. ``status`` is the venue status text
(``online`` when trading normally; ``null`` when not reported) and ``alias`` names
the product whose order book this one shares (``null`` for a standalone book).
ProductSummary.title: ProductSummary

ProductsPayload.description:
Coinbase or demo spot products, and with ``--kind`` the read-only futures listing.

The four futures fields are omitted from the JSON unless ``kind`` is ``future`` or
``all``, so the default spot payload keeps its exact bytes (ADR 0126). With ``kind:
future`` the spot ``products`` list is empty and the spot catalog is not read.
ProductsPayload.title: ProductsPayload

ProductsReport.description: Read-only USD spot catalog without secrets.
ProductsReport.title: ProductsReport

ProtectionEvidenceResponse.description: Strict protection evidence; exact decimal strings, or null for unresolved inventory.

stop_side.description: Closing side the stop must use, or null when flat or inventory is unresolved.
stop_side.title: Stop Side

venue_resting.description: Fresh identified OPEN state reads contributed with matching local geometry.
venue_resting.title: Venue Resting

worker_dependent.description: True for the paper synthetic stop. That cover is not a venue order.
worker_dependent.title: Worker Dependent

observed_at.description: Latest relevant venue order-state receipt time; never a local row update.
observed_at.title: Observed At

verified_at.description: Oldest contributing fresh OPEN receipt; not a venue geometry audit.
verified_at.title: Verified At

freshness.description: Conservative order-state recency, not geometry auditing.
freshness.title: Freshness

evaluated_at.description: UTC reporting clock used to assess venue order-state age.
evaluated_at.title: Evaluated At

geometry_basis.description: Persisted geometry vs working target or stop-limit trigger, not venue audited.
geometry_basis.title: Geometry Basis

ProtectionEvidenceResponse.title: ProtectionEvidenceResponse

QuoteReconciliationRow.description: One quote currency: venue balance next to managed working buy notional.

note.default: Quote funds are a shared pool: foreign cash and managed reservations cannot be attributed exactly, so the venue balance is disclosed next to managed working buy notional instead of being reconciled.
note.title: Note

QuoteReconciliationRow.title: QuoteReconciliationRow

ReadinessAccountCaps.description:
Account-level capacity in the policy's quote currency (ADR 0106 scope).

``capital_base`` is observed venue available quote plus managed long inventory cost
and working buy-entry reservations — never a bot allocation or duplicated ledger
cash. Caps and capacities are ``None`` when the venue balance is unknown; they are
never guessed. Books quoted in another currency are excluded and disclosed.
ReadinessAccountCaps.title: ReadinessAccountCaps

ReadinessAssetCapRow.description: One base asset's exposure inside one portfolio versus its per-asset cap.
ReadinessAssetCapRow.title: ReadinessAssetCapRow

ReadinessDeploymentRow.description: One in-scope book's allocation and capacity facts (no order payloads).
ReadinessDeploymentRow.title: ReadinessDeploymentRow

ReadinessFeeEvidence.description:
Account fee evidence and every scoped paper book's assumption against it.

``unavailable_reason`` is set when the account rates could not be read; assumed
paper rates are still listed, but no optimism conclusion is drawn from invented
numbers. Demo data is labeled and never compared against real expectations.

comparison_note.default: Paper books carry documented maker/taker assumptions; live books pay venue-recorded fees. Backtest and paper suggestions prefill from the account's reported rates; older runs may assume cheaper fees. Compare with `thytrader-operator fees`.
comparison_note.title: Comparison Note

ReadinessFeeEvidence.title: ReadinessFeeEvidence

ReadinessFeeGapRow.description:
One paper book's assumed fees versus the account's reported fee evidence.

A gap is ``account rate - assumed rate``: positive means the paper book assumes
cheaper fees than the account reports, so its results read more optimistic.
ReadinessFeeGapRow.title: ReadinessFeeGapRow

ReadinessFinding.description: One advisory, violation, or unknown-capacity observation with a stable code.
ReadinessFinding.title: ReadinessFinding

ReadinessFuturesPosition.description: One external CFM position: unmanaged, never part of any book.
ReadinessFuturesPosition.title: ReadinessFuturesPosition

ReadinessFuturesSection.description:
The CFM futures account from the newest mirror snapshot (ADR 0127).

Every amount is USD and is never added to a USDC amount. Coinbase counts the USDC
spot balance as futures collateral, so ``futures_buying_power`` is shared with USDC
spot capital (``collateral_note``). ``positions`` is ``null`` when unknown.
ReadinessFuturesSection.title: ReadinessFuturesSection

ReadinessInventoryEvidence.description: Storage-read completeness and economic completeness are independent evidence.
ReadinessInventoryEvidence.title: ReadinessInventoryEvidence

ReadinessPortfolioSection.description:
One portfolio's caps, exposure, and both breaker tiers side by side.

``tighter_daily_breaker`` only *names* which daily-loss stop binds first; nothing
here tightens either breaker. Exposure caps are fractions of the portfolio's
configured ``capital_quote`` exactly as the entry gate applies them (ADR 0091).
ReadinessPortfolioSection.title: ReadinessPortfolioSection

ReadinessSeverity.description: How hard one readiness finding should press on the operator.
ReadinessSeverity.title: ReadinessSeverity

ReadinessVenueQuote.description:
One quote currency's venue balance, exactly as observed.

Balances are disclosed (``balances_omitted=false``) because the report exists to
compare them against caps. Account identifiers and secrets stay out.
ReadinessVenueQuote.title: ReadinessVenueQuote

Queued and running research jobs, and how long the oldest queued one has waited.

``queued`` jobs wait for a free research worker; ``running`` jobs hold a worker.
ResearchQueueReport.title: ResearchQueueReport

ResearchWorkerReport.description: One research worker process's latest self-report (ADR 0092).
ResearchWorkerReport.title: ResearchWorkerReport

ResearchWorkersPayload.description:
Research worker pool liveness and queue depth (ADR 0092).

``configured_workers`` is the pool size the workers report (null until one has
reported); ``live_workers`` heartbeated recently. ``queue`` sums both queues;
``research_jobs`` holds backtests and studies, ``portfolio_backtests`` the rest.

SignalTraceRecord.description:
One auditable condition result for a completed evaluation candle.

``exit_condition`` is the ``exits.signal_exit`` outcome on this candle. It is present
only when the strategy declares a signal exit (ADR 0093) and omitted from canonical
bytes otherwise, so every older trace keeps its fingerprint. It is evaluated on every
candle; whether a position was open to act on it is the simulator's concern.
SignalTraceRecord.title: SignalTraceRecord

VenueListingEvidence.description:
Completeness of one venue listing read.

``status`` is ``complete`` only within the configured credential's visibility:
the adapter paged the whole requested listing and every page parsed. A read
failure or pagination anomaly leaves it ``unavailable`` and every dependent
comparison unknown (fail closed). The adapter never returns partial rows.
VenueListingEvidence.title: VenueListingEvidence

VenueReconciliationPayload.description: Everything the venue-wide comparison observed, with scope made explicit.

note.default: A healthy local ledger is not venue reconciliation: managed inventory and working orders are compared against a fresh venue-wide listing. External (foreign) holdings and orders are disclosed, not treated as errors and not flattened. Unknown listings make dependent comparisons unknown. Reads are sequential, not atomic, and cover only the configured credential's venue visibility.
note.title: Note
